prompt: Create a candid, realistic smartphone-style photo of a smiling young woman at a lively outdoor night market food court. She has long wavy dark brown hair worn loose, natural makeup, small gold hoop earrings, layered delicate gold necklaces, and a bright royal blue oversized hoodie with black bottoms. Her left hand holds a black smartphone near the lower-left of the frame, and her right hand rests near a clear plastic cup of water on the lower-right. In the foreground are exactly 2 white disposable paper bowls: one bowl on the left filled with glossy grilled meat in dark sauce, and one bowl on the right filled with white rice topped by a sunny-side-up fried egg with a bright orange yolk. The setting is a crowded night market under a black tarp canopy with metal poles and scaffolding, bright overhead bulbs, blurred diners sitting on stools, food stalls in the background, and a visible sign reading THAI FOOD. Use realistic ambient night lighting, slight wide-angle phone-camera perspective, shallow depth of field, wet reflective pavement, casual candid composition, high detail skin texture, natural facial proportions, and no studio polish. Make it feel like an authentic travel dinner snapshot taken with a phone, vertical 3:4 framing, subject centered, food prominently visible in the foreground.

promptZh: 创作一张写实、手机拍摄风格的抓拍照片，拍摄对象是一位在热闹的户外夜市美食广场用餐的年轻女性，她面带微笑。她坐在铺着红白格塑料桌布的桌子旁，身体微微前倾，直视镜头，露出温暖自然的笑容。她留着一头长波浪 深棕色 卷发，妆容自然，佩戴小巧的金色圆环耳环和精致的叠戴金项链，身穿一件亮眼的 宝蓝色 大码连帽衫，下身搭配黑色裤子。她的左手拿着一部黑色智能手机，位于画面左下方，右手放在右下方的一杯透明塑料水杯旁。前景中有 2 个白色的纸质一次性碗：左边的碗里盛着淋有深色酱汁的油亮烤肉，右边的碗里盛着白米饭，上面盖着一个蛋黄呈亮橙色的太阳蛋。在米饭碗旁放一个透明塑料水杯，画面左下角边缘露出部分白色塑料叉子。背景是拥挤的夜市，上方是黑色篷布遮阳棚，配有金属杆和脚手架，头顶灯泡明亮，背景中可以看到模糊的食客和食品摊位，并有一个写着 THAI FOOD 的招牌。采用写实的夜间环境光，轻微的手机广角镜头视角，浅景深，湿润的反光路面，随意的抓拍构图，高细节的皮肤纹理，自然的脸部比例，无影棚修饰感。营造出一种真实的旅行晚餐手机抓拍氛围，3:4 竖构图，主体居中，前景中的食物清晰可见。
